name: rooms.join
purpose: Join (or start) a huddle in a channel as the calling user; returns an AWS Chime meeting+attendee under call.free_willy for the media layer. Joins a real call visibly -- do not call without a human in the loop.
source: 3kh0/slack-datamine, build 132396 (committed webpack mining); ingoau/huddlefm (source read, commit 2097946; not live-tested); LeafdTK/huddlecast (source read, commit 65a041d; not live-tested); deployor/hq-fishbowl (source read; trusted)

channel_id.desc: Channel to join/start the huddle in.

regions.desc: Chime media region to request. Working clients use ap-southeast-2 (huddlefm), us-west-1 (huddlecast), us-east-2 (hq-fishbowl).

multidevice.desc: Sent as "true" by huddlefm and "false" by huddlecast; omitted by deployor/hq-fishbowl, so not required. Meaning unconfirmed.

token.desc: xoxc client token; also needs Cookie: d=<xoxd>. Host must be <workspace>.slack.com.

params_source: ingoau/huddlefm (source read, commit 2097946; not live-tested); LeafdTK/huddlecast (source read, commit 65a041d; not live-tested) -- 'required' is inferred from these clients always sending them; deployor/hq-fishbowl (source read, commit c1619f1, 2025-08-06; trusted source): only channel_id, regions, token + Cookie header are sent, no _x_* fields

response.call.free_willy.meeting: Chime Meeting object (MeetingId, MediaRegion, ExternalMeetingId, MediaPlacement, MeetingFeatures|null)
response.call.free_willy.attendee: Chime Attendee object (AttendeeId, ExternalUserId, JoinToken, Capabilities)

response_source: ingoau/huddlefm (source read, commit 2097946; not live-tested); LeafdTK/huddlecast (source read, commit 65a041d; not live-tested) -- partial: only fields these clients read
safety_note_for_agents: This catalog documents Slack's UNDOCUMENTED/internal API surface for a specific workspace (Hack Club, Enterprise Grid). Calling an undocumented method with params_known=false means you would be guessing params against a real backend with unknown side effects -- do not do this against a real account/token without a human in the loop, and never call anything shaped like a write (*.delete, *.set, *.remove, *.create, *.update, and similar) without explicit human confirmation and a clear understanding of the blast radius, even when params_known=true.
